name: Cache Filter Visible Index Binary Search

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native release build, criterion benches (macOS arm64)
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Cache Filter Visible Index Binary Search Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

`CacheDynamicFilterState::visible_index_for_key` counts included keys before the source position linearly (O(n) per update/refresh/move once any key is excluded). The filtered order is the included keys as a subsequence of the source order (except possibly the key itself at a stale place), so a binary search over it by source position returns the same index in O(log m) lookups.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** binary search of the filtered order by source position.
**Allowed changes:** `visible_index_for_key` in `crates/src/collections/operators/cache_dynamic_filter_state_impl.rs`.
**Forbidden in this experiment:** list filter scans, inline transform scans, any other operator.
measurementPlanMarkdown:

Focused tests: `collections::tests::{subset_operator_indexes,transforms_filters,ordered_emission_core,snapshot_diff_indexes,index_contract_harness,operator_bookkeeping_costs,operator_input_interop}`; clippy/fmt. Bench: `hot_paths` vs `base`. Pass: tests green and `cache-hot/update-filter-half` at least 5x faster with no regression > 5% elsewhere in `cache-hot`.

`update-filter-half` drops from ~25 us to sub-microsecond.
